task: crack vs no-crack, one independently generated synthetic scene per unit; no pit model
acquisition: angle beam 16 coherent shots, fixed grain/clutter shared; only electronics averaged
selection: minimum validation BCE, never test scores
threshold: 99th percentile of gated CNN logits on held-out normal DR units (higher); strict greater-than; gate AND CNN
preprocessing: per-scan outside-window robust noise scaling + asinh/4; low-pass decimation 1:4; RF/envelope/mask
assumptions: nominal wall geometry and nominal steel refracted angle supplied to window generator
measured noisy temperature, never true temperature, used for gating
generic carbon-steel simulator, not calibrated POSCO grade
no true wedge/angle drift, rain/internal-water boundary physics, off-axis or multi-defect model
